PM Modi Chairs Union Council of Ministers Meeting

Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a meeting of the Union Council of Ministers at Bharat Mandapam. The meeting focused on reviewing government schemes and performance. Only cabinet ministers were invited, with state ministers not included in this particular session.
